# npm-release

> Release npm libraries with a manual first publish, `npm trust` for OIDC Trusted Publishing, then tag-triggered automatic publishes (`git push` of a `v*` tag). Use when creating a new npm library and shipping it, setting up or fixing automated npm releases, wiring GitHub Actions to publish on tag push, enabling npm provenance, or migrating a repo off release-please / NPM_TOKEN. Covers single-package and pnpm workspaces monorepo.

## Install

### APM (recommended)

```bash
apm install mizchi/skills/npm-release
```

Or declare it in `apm.yml` for a reproducible setup:

```yaml
dependencies:
  apm:
    - mizchi/skills/npm-release
```

then run `apm install`.
